slug: 2025-10-02 Raxio Opens Angola's Largest Data Centre in Landmark 30 Million Expansion

facts.fact: Raxio Group opened Raxio Angola (AG1) in Cacuaco, Luanda Province, up to 3 MW and over 800 racks, a commercial data centre.
Raxio says Raxio Angola (AG1) is built to Tier III standard, the only commercial data centre in Angola so; no certifying body is named.
